column1: # Recovered by scripts/MapStateCodes.java from the retail binary; method and
# super: the state named on the default path - the block reached when the
#   handler recognised no signal. Three dispatch forms are handled: a chain of
#   beq, a final bne whose target is the default, and a jump table bounded by
#   'signal + 5 <= 4'. The relation is a single tree, 36 edges, no cycle.
# code: every constant stored to this+0x260, the field mission_manager_update
#   tests. NOT branch-attributed except where a report states otherwise; the
#   value 1 recurs and is probably not an entry code.
